name: bot-agora.retry-rules.v1

inputs.idempotency_enforced: boolean: server DOCUMENTS that it enforces Idempotency-Key for this write

rules_in_order.reason: Client error; retrying the same request will not fix it.
Safe methods have no side effects.
Connection never established; request was not sent.

rules_in_order.verdict: safe_to_retry if (op==read or idempotency_enforced or method in PUT,DELETE) else reconcile_first

rules_in_order.reason: Server enforces the key; reuse the SAME key on retry.
Payment without enforced idempotency: duplicate charge risk. Reconcile manually.
Ambiguous: request may have been applied. Look up the resource before retrying.
PUT/DELETE are idempotent by HTTP semantics (if the server follows them).
Unknown outcome for a non-idempotent write.

notes: An Idempotency-Key header alone is not a guarantee unless the server enforces it.
